from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOTS = (Path("src"), Path("scripts"))
MARKERS = ("TODO", "FIXME", "XXX", "HACK")
issues: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
files = 0


def record(path: Path, line: int, rule: str, detail: str) -> None:
    issues.append(
        {
            "path": path.as_posix(),
            "line": line,
            "rule": rule,
            "detail": detail,
        }
    )


for root in ROOTS:
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*.py")):
        files += 1
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for line_number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
            for marker in MARKERS:
                if marker in line:
                    record(path, line_number, "unfinished-marker", marker)
        try:
            tree = ast.parse(text, filename=path.as_posix())
        except SyntaxError as exc:
            record(path, exc.lineno or 0, "syntax-error", str(exc))
            continue
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.ExceptHandler) and node.type is None:
                record(path, node.lineno, "bare-except", "Bare exception handler")
            if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                defaults = [*node.args.defaults]
                defaults.extend(item for item in node.args.kw_defaults if item is not None)
                for default in defaults:
                    if isinstance(default, (ast.List, ast.Dict, ast.Set)):
                        record(
                            path,
                            node.lineno,
                            "mutable-default",
                            f"Mutable default in {node.name}",
                        )

report = {
    "schema": "aspenops.comprehensive-hygiene-audit/v1",
    "files_scanned": files,
    "issue_count": len(issues),
    "issues": issues,
    "decision": "PASS" if not issues else "FAIL",
}
output = Path("var/comprehensive-closure/hygiene-audit.json")
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
if issues:
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))
